definitions: To move in a secret and stealthy manner.
To take or bring something surreptitiously.
To inform an authority figure about someone's misdeeds.
examples: He tried to sneak out of the house unnoticed.
She managed to sneak a biscuit from the jar.
The child would often sneak on his classmates.
pastTenses: sneaked or snuck (past simple), sneaked or have snuck (past perfect)
